title: Batch-of-Thought: Cross-Instance Learning for Enhanced LLM Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on a novel reasoning methodology (Batch-of-Thought) for LLMs. While it is tested on a wide range of tasks, including some that involve moral scenarios from the MMLU benchmark, the core research is not centered on evaluating or benchmarking ethics, morals, or faith. The paper includes a standard 'Ethics Statement' section, which the prompt specifies does not count towards this classification.
